example_sentences_in_bangla: বাইরে পা-গাড়ির ঘন্টার শব্দ শোনা গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He went to the market on his bicycle.
The sound of a bicycle bell was heard outside.
history: This term appears in the works of Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay, reflecting early 20th-century rural Bengali life when bicycles were a novel mode of transport.
note: An older colloquial term for bicycle, now largely replaced by 'সাইকেল' in modern usage.
